scope.summary: Implement the Pen tool operator surface + typed command: place anchors and straight/curved segments, connect to ANY existing network anchor (not only endpoints), drag to create mirrored tangent handles; authors a StudioVectorPath or contributes to a StudioVectorNetwork when it joins edges/creates regions, never silently collapsing network topology. Model-authored edits emit studio.vector events through sandbox->validation->promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Pen tool draws paths + joins network anchors; typed command; author_id + manual entry
proof_targets: Argus Pen inspect + network-topology preservation test
expected_tests: argus: Pen tool reachable via stable author_id; places anchors + drags handles
test: pen connects to interior network anchor + preserves network topology

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Drawing with the Pen tool

risk_if_missed: No primary drawing tool; vector authoring unusable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
